name: Alignment Shield (alignment)
body:
School abjuration; Level cleric/oracle 1, inquisitor 1, paladin 1 sorcerer/wizard 1

EFFECT

Duration 1 min/level (D)
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)
Target Restrictions Selected

DESCRIPTION

When a wordspell with this effect word is cast, the wordcaster selects one alignment: good, evil, chaotic, or lawful. The target of this wordspell is protected from that alignment and receives a +2 resistance bonus on saving throws made on spells and effects from creatures of that alignment. The target of a wordspell with this effect word can choose to end this effect as an immediate action to reroll any one saving throw made against a spell or effect from the chosen alignment, but must take the second result, even if it is worse.
